actual_scope: For four binary corank-one requests with pairwise orthogonal rank-one kernels, prove the joint full-guard probability is strictly below the product of marginals in every m>=4, and prove the leading relative deficit is 12(7/9)^(m-1).
scope_change_reason: Original successor counting work on Open next question 2 of PR4275, using its character law as a cited step. This is not an audit of another result or a full supplier.
bottleneck_link: Shared-header pricing requires joint probabilities. This proves a dependence penalty in a fixed binary model; physical caller costs remain unknown and kappa is unchanged.
stop_rule: Stop after the four-event all-dimension product inequality and leading asymptotic deficit; package the first verified result without extending to k>=5.
evidence: PROOF.md combines a uniform tail estimate for m>=85 with 81 exact finite comparisons. verify.py enumerates all 4096 characters by two evaluations and checks a separate bounded convolution.
author: Nick Petalas
ai_assistance: Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.
